_note: v0.5 3D engine. fps 60 = very smooth motion (the channel standard; never go below 60). scale 1.0 = crisp, no upscaling. dissolve = soft cut length in frames inside one narration unit (14 frames = 0.23 s at 60 fps). parts = resumable render parts for the long video and the number of parallel cloud jobs (3D at 60 fps is heavy: a 30 min video needs about 70 parts so every GitHub job stays well under its 5 hour limit).
